observations.reason: All listed subjects have children. The agreed strict-thin gate applies to terminal subjects; no content is changed to improve a metric.

scope_limit: This is a structural comparison of the full corpus. It does not claim a new semantic reread of all 1901 old bodies; source authors and root reviewed the changed content packages separately.

strict_summary.metric: Only explicit routes, normalized aliases, excluding declared direct parent/children. Transitive kinship is not removed; root parent empty string is not treated as an orphan.

initial_aggregate_false_positive.resolution: Apply the agreed canon to terminal subjects: 1754/1754 terminal subjects have strict outgoing routes, including 1686 old and 68 new. The two nonterminal observations remain nonblocking.
